props.title: What this guide establishes
props.text: The linked sources support the three principles. The Kages recommendations are editorial advice, not measured performance claims or proof of parity with another product.

props.title: Meaning, behavior, access.
props.description: Three principles connect presentation quality to a reader's ability to understand and act.
